concerns.text: Functional requirement FR-001 (SVD extraction of top‑k singular vectors) is not referenced by any task in tasks.md; no task is tagged or described as implementing this requirement.
Functional requirement FR-002 (cosine similarity between subspace bases) lacks any explicit task coverage; no task mentions computing or validating similarity metrics.
Functional requirement FR-003 (identify and rank high‑logit tokens) is not linked to any task; tasks do not cite FR‑003 or describe token‑ranking implementation beyond generic placeholders.

Functional requirement FR-004 (permutation test with ≥1,000 iterations) is absent from the task list; no task is tagged with this requirement or describes building the null distribution and p‑value calculation.
Functional requirement FR-005 (mean embedding projection via W_E × f) is not covered by any task; tasks do not mention this computation or reference FR‑005.
Functional requirement FR-006 (acquire and validate raw frequency datasets with ≥1 000 000 tokens) has no corresponding task; the only related task T091 is marked incomplete.
Functional requirement FR-007 (acquire and process WALS and SentEval data for external validation) is not addressed by any completed task; no task cites FR‑007.
Functional requirement FR-008 (vocabulary mapping layer) is only partially covered by T044/T044‑Fallback, but those tasks lack explicit FR‑008 tagging; the requirement remains unlinked.
Success criterion SC-001 (anisotropy bias measured against within‑language baseline) is not referenced by any task; no task mentions generating confidence intervals for this metric.
Success criterion SC-002 (token‑overlap ratio compared to random baseline) lacks task coverage; no task is tied to SC‑002.
Success criterion SC-003 (p‑value from permutation test) is not linked to any task; the permutation‑test tasks exist but do not explicitly cite SC‑003.
Success criterion SC-004 (correlation with SentEval performance drop) is missing from the task list; no task references this validation metric.

Success criterion SC-005 (feasibility on 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM runner) is not covered; while task T080 updates the workflow, the original plan description still lists insufficient resources, and no task explicitly verifies SC‑005.
The quickstart guide (quickstart.md) is not referenced by any task; there are no tasks that generate, test, or validate the quickstart steps.
